item.title: Have You Seen My Cat?
item.summary: A neighbour leaves a voicemail about her lost cat: what the cat looks like and what to do if you see her.
item.transcript_text: Hi, this is Dilya from flat twelve. Sorry to call so late. My cat is lost. Her name is Mosh, and she's small and grey with white feet. She has a red collar. She went out this morning, and she isn't home now. Can you look in your garden and near the garages, please? If you see her, please call me back or knock on my door. Thank you so much. Bye!
